title: Noise action on a Fourier component
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $(\psi_a)_{a\in\iota}$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function and is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. For $n\in\mathbb N$, a parameter $\rho\in[0,1]$, a function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and a coordinate set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, applying the product noise operator to $f$ and then taking its Fourier component supported on $S$ gives $\rho^{|S|}$ times the Fourier component of $f$ supported on $S$.
hypotheses_covered: Basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
